mapper.select: select a.id, a.factory_id, a.process_id, a.attr_id, a.required, a.sort_order, a.enable_flag, d.attr_code, d.attr_name, d.attr_type, d.attr_unit, d.options_json from qxx_wm_outsource_process_attr a join qxx_md_attr_def d on d.attr_id = a.attr_id where a.factory_id = #{factoryId} and a.process_id = #{processId} and a.enable_flag = '1' order by a.sort_order, a.id
mapper.insert: insert into qxx_wm_outsource_process_attr (factory_id, process_id, attr_id, required, sort_order, enable_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{factoryId}, #{processId}, #{attrId}, #{required}, #{sortOrder}, #{enableFlag}, #{createBy}, now())
